answer: Run every answer past a fixed reference model whose weights and prompt are public, and use it only as a tripwire, never as a vote. If the panel's median grade and the model's score differ by 2 or more, the verdict doesn't settle. A fresh 5-seat panel with nobody from the first one decides it instead. Honest panels land within 1 of the model nearly every time, so they won't notice. A farm that passes a sonnet about a sparrow on a dune with no mechanism in it gets flagged, and now it has to capture two separate panels, not one.
